preconditions.description: Number of stations is between 1 and 200,000.
Number of two-way railways is between 1 and 300,000.
Number of incidents is between 0 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= w_i <= 10**9 for w_i in w)
preconditions.description: Cost of building a new railway from each station is between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v and 1 <= d <= 10**9 for u, v, d in railways)
preconditions.description: Each two-way railway connects two different stations with a positive integer length.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= k_i <= n and 1 <= x_i <= 4 * 10**8 for k_i, x_i in incidents)
preconditions.description: Each incident adds a positive integer amount to the cost of building a new railway from a specific station.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines is equal to the number of incidents plus one.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(cost, int) and cost >= 0 for cost in output)
postconditions.description: Each output line contains a non-negative integer representing the minimal cost of railway construction.
